en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a narrow irrigation ditch bordered by overhanging trees whose branches form a shaded tunnel over the water. The still water reflects the trees. On the right side, part of a simple wooden fence or small bridge is visible. Beneath the image is a printed caption in red identifying the scene as an irrigation ditch near Hanford, California, with a red number printed in the lower right corner.
